title: Listening test: can you hear the 38 973 ₸ between Casio PX-770 and Celviano AP-270? (rewritten: guess game removed)

format: E09 blind test rewritten as an open A/B listen with no guessing, 12–15 s, hands plus real close-up piano sound, loopable
first_frame: Top-down vertical shot of two black digital pianos side by side. The hands are already mid-phrase on the left one, and the sound starts in frame 1. On-screen text: «38 973 ₸ разницы. Это слышно?». No logo, store name or «мы».

what_happens: 0–2 s: one short phrase on the PX-770, with the phone 20–30 cm from the speaker; the hook text sits over it. 2–5 s: the same phrase on the AP-270, with the model name and price captioned on each. 5–9 s: the two halves of the phrase alternate between the pianos so the ear can compare. 9–12 s: the one line where the two site cards differ (polyphony 128 vs 192) appears over a wide shot of both pianos. 12–14 s: the end frame cuts back to the first note so the video loops. We give no verdict either way; the viewer decides. Both pianos use the same preset and volume, logged by the editor.
why_stop: Music starts in frame 1, and the hook asks a real question about money that every buyer comparing listings has: can you hear what the extra money buys?
why_share_or_save: A parent who is choosing sends it to a partner («слышишь разницу?»). Musicians send it to friends to argue about whether price is audible.
